method:
Build docs/countries.json for the country ranking page (docs/countries.html).

Per country:
  - price per acre: median USD/acre of land listings in the app (falls back to
    every listing with an acreage when a country has fewer than 5 land rows)
  - quality of life: UN Human Development Index 2023 (HDR 2025 data file)
  - climate: monthly normals 2016-2025 from the Open-Meteo archive (ERA5),
    averaged over three sample points taken from where that country's listings
    actually are (20th / 50th / 80th percentile of latitude)
  - tax: estimated cost for a foreign individual buying a ~US$1M second home and
    holding it 10 years: one-off purchase taxes + foreign-buyer surcharges + 10x
    annual property/wealth tax, as % of price. Rough, hand-maintained, see TAX.

Usage: python3 scripts/country_stats.py   (climate cached in scripts/geo/climate_cache.json)

tax.note: acquisition + registration tax on assessed value; fixed-asset + city-planning tax ~1.7% of assessed value/yr

income_tax.note: 45% national + 10% local. Non-permanent residents (first 5 of 10 yrs) only pay on foreign income they bring into Japan.

residency.note: resident only if your domicile is in Japan or you've lived there a year; 90-day visa-free visits stay non-resident.

tax.note: provincial land transfer tax; federal ban on foreign purchase of homes in cities until 2027 (rural/recreational exempt); BC adds 20% for foreigners in some regions

income_tax.note: federal + provincial (BC/ON ~53.5%); worldwide income.

home.note: a year-round home is a significant tie: CRA can treat you as resident under 183 days if your ties elsewhere are weak.

tax.note: state/county transfer tax ~0.5-1%; property tax ~1.1%/yr (MA)

income_tax.note: 37% federal + state (MA 9% over $1M, UT 4.65%); worldwide income. US citizens pay this wherever they live.

residency.note: 183-day test weighted over 3 years: coming every year, 122+ days/yr makes you resident (121 is safe). Closer-connection exception (Form 8840) can protect you up to 182 days. ESTA visitors max 90 days per visit; longer needs a B-2 visa.

tax.note: 3.5% Grunderwerbsteuer + 1.1% land-register fee; Grundsteuer tiny; EU nationals treated as locals

income_tax.note: 50% above ~€100k, 55% above €1M; capital income 27.5% flat; worldwide.

home.note: any home you can use makes you resident. Second-home rule: if your centre of life has been abroad 5+ yrs, using the Austrian home on no more than 70 days a year keeps you non-resident (keep a day log).

tax.note: IMT ~6% + 0.8% stamp duty; IMI 0.3-0.45% + AIMI above €600k

income_tax.note: 48% + 5% solidarity; 28% flat on investment income. IFICI ('NHR 2.0'): 20% on qualifying jobs and most foreign income exempt for 10 yrs, if you qualify.

home.note: a home kept as your habitual residence can make you resident under 183 days.

tax.note: foreigners pay 4% flat stamp duty; some states add a foreign levy (e.g. Penang 3%); RM1M+ minimum price for foreigners in most states

income_tax.note: foreign income brought in by individuals is exempt until end-2036.

residency.note: 182 days, or shorter stays linked to longer ones across years.

tax.note: transfer fee 2% (often split); foreigners cannot own land: condo or 30-yr lease only

income_tax.note: since 2024, foreign income is taxed if brought into Thailand (not if kept abroad). LTR-visa holders: foreign income exempt.

tax.note: notary + registry; contribuciones ~1% of fiscal value (rural land often exempt)

income_tax.note: foreigners pay only on Chilean income for their first 3 years, then worldwide.

residency.note: 183 days in any 12 months (or across 2 consecutive years).

tax.note: 2% PCC on resale; property tax per m², very low; farmland restricted for non-farmers

income_tax.note: 32% + 4% solidarity above PLN 1M; 19% on capital income; 19% flat option for business income.

home.note: centre of vital interests in Poland makes you resident.

tax.note: notary + registration; building tax ~0.1-0.2%/yr; non-EU buyers cannot own land directly

income_tax.note: 10% flat income tax (plus health contributions); dividends 16%.

home.note: centre of vital interests in Romania makes you resident.

tax.note: ITBI 2-3% + registry; IPTU/ITR; limits on foreign ownership of rural land

income_tax.note: 27.5% on salary; 15% on offshore investments since 2024; new minimum tax on high earners from 2026.

residency.note: 183 days in 12 months; a permanent visa makes you resident from day one.

tax.note: BPHTB 5% + notary; foreigners only via Hak Pakai (right-of-use) or company

income_tax.note: worldwide; skilled expats can elect Indonesian-income-only for the first 4 years.

tax.note: no stamp duty or capital-gains tax; council rates; foreigners mostly banned from buying existing homes

income_tax.note: new residents: most foreign income exempt for the first 4 years; no capital-gains tax.

home.note: a 'permanent place of abode' in NZ makes you resident whatever the days.

tax.note: provincial stamp tax + deed costs; rural land limits for foreigners

income_tax.note: worldwide; plus an annual wealth tax (bienes personales).

residency.note: resident after 12 months or with permanent residency.

tax.note: 4% title-deed fee (often split); property tax 0.1-0.6%/yr

income_tax.note: worldwide for residents.

home.note: settling (domicile) in Turkey makes you resident.

Switzerland.price_basis: all land listings (mostly small or few plots: not comparable)

tax.note: cantonal transfer tax + notary; wealth + property tax; Lex Koller caps holiday-home sales to foreigners

income_tax.note: varies a lot by canton (Zug ~22%, Zurich ~40%); non-working foreigners can negotiate lump-sum (forfait) taxation in many cantons.

home.note: domicile with intent to stay makes you resident; a holiday home alone usually doesn't.

residency.note: 90 days without work (30 days if working).

tax.note: stamp duty abolished Aug 2020 (legal/registration costs only); 10% capital gains tax when you sell; foreigners can't buy residential land inside town boundaries and must build (FJD 250k+) on vacant residential land within 2 yrs; 12.5% VAT on some sales

income_tax.note: residents: 0% to FJD 30k, 18-20% to FJD 270k, then 33-39% (39% above FJD 1M); non-residents 20% from the first dollar. Dividends untaxed since 2017; 10% CGT on gains, for residents also on foreign assets. Workers on contracts of up to 3 yrs: foreign income exempt.

home.note: domicile in Fiji (your permanent home) makes you resident.

residency.note: 183 days in any 12 months, or domicile.

bands.nonresident: 20% from the first dollar, same rates above FJD 270k
bands.capital_gains: 10% on disposal of capital assets incl. land/buildings and shares; residents also on foreign assets (credit for foreign tax)

Georgia.price_basis: all land listings (mostly small or few plots: not comparable)

tax.note: flat registration fee; property tax 0-1% only above an income threshold; foreigners cannot buy farmland

income_tax.note: 20% flat; foreign income exempt (territorial); 1% turnover tax for small businesses.

New Caledonia.hdi_note: French territory, not in UN data: France's HDI used as a stand-in

tax.note: rough: French-style registration duties + notary (~11%)

income_tax.note: rough: own territorial income tax, top ~40%.

home.note: your 'foyer' (main home) there makes you resident.

tax.note: rough: leasehold only (75-yr leases); stamp duty + lease registration; no income or property tax

income_tax.note: no personal income tax.

Grenada.price_basis: all land listings (mostly small or few plots: not comparable)

tax.note: Alien Landholding Licence 10% of value for foreigners; buyer stamp duty ~1%

income_tax.note: rough: top rate 28%.

Australia.price_basis: all land listings (mostly small or few plots: not comparable)

tax.note: stamp duty + 8-9% foreign surcharge; land-tax foreign surcharge 2-5%/yr; ban on foreigners buying established homes 2025-27

income_tax.note: 45% + 2% Medicare; temporary-visa residents don't pay on foreign income.

home.note: a permanent place of abode in Australia makes you resident.

United Kingdom.price_basis: estates incl. houses (few listings: not comparable)

tax.note: Scotland: LBTT up to 12% (~10% effective at £2M) + 8% ADS if you own another home anywhere (reclaimable if it becomes your main home); council tax

income_tax.note: Scotland 48% top rate; new arrivals: foreign income and gains exempt for the first 4 years (FIG regime).

home.note: Statutory Residence Test: a home available to you plus 90+ days the year before = 2 ties, so returning visitors become resident from 121 days.

France.price_basis: estates incl. houses (few listings: not comparable)

tax.note: notary + registration ~7.5-8% on resale; taxe foncière; IFI wealth tax above €1.3M

income_tax.note: 45% + 4% high-income surcharge; ~30% flat on investment income; impatriate regime for workers moving in.

home.note: your 'foyer' (main home/family) or main work in France makes you resident; a holiday home alone doesn't.

South Africa.price_basis: estates incl. houses (few listings: not comparable)

tax.note: transfer duty up to 13% above ~R12M; municipal rates; register foreign funds with the Reserve Bank to repatriate later

income_tax.note: worldwide; dividends 20%, capital gains effectively up to ~18%.

home.note: 'ordinarily resident' if SA is your real home.

residency.note: physical-presence test: 91+ days every year for 6 years and 915+ in the last 5 (so ~183/yr if you come every year).

Italy.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 9% registration tax on a second-home resale (on cadastral value); IMU on second homes

income_tax.note: 26% on investment income. New residents can pay a flat €200k/yr on ALL foreign income for 15 yrs; 7% flat for foreign pensioners in small southern towns.

home.note: your habitual abode or centre of interests in Italy makes you resident.

Spain.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: ITP 6-10% by region on resale; IBI; regional wealth tax

income_tax.note: savings income 19-30%. Beckham law: 24% on Spanish work income, foreign income exempt, for 6 yrs. Regional wealth tax.

home.note: centre of economic interests or family in Spain makes you resident.

Greece.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 3% transfer tax + fees; ENFIA

income_tax.note: non-dom option: flat €100k/yr on all foreign income (needs €500k investment); 7% flat for foreign pensioners; half-tax for relocating workers.

home.note: permanent home/centre of vital interests in Greece makes you resident.

Croatia.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 3% transfer tax; holiday-home property tax since 2025

income_tax.note: top rate 30-33% depending on city; 12% on capital income.

home.note: owning or renting a home you use (domicile) can make you resident.

Montenegro.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 3% transfer tax

income_tax.note: 9-15% progressive.

Cyprus.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: land-registry transfer fees 3-8% (halved on resale without VAT); no annual property tax; non-EU buyers need a permit

income_tax.note: non-dom residents: 0% on dividends and interest for 17 years; foreign pensions 5%.

home.note: 60-day rule: with a Cyprus home, a local job/company and no other tax residence you can choose to be resident after 60 days (then non-dom: 0% on dividends).

Malta.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 5% stamp duty; no property tax; non-EU buyers need an AIP permit outside special designated areas

income_tax.note: non-domiciled residents pay nothing on foreign income they keep abroad (minimum €5k tax).

home.note: intention to live in Malta makes you resident.

UAE.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: Dubai Land Department 4%; no property tax

income_tax.note: no personal income tax.

home.note: 90 days + a permanent home + UAE residence visa or job gets you a UAE tax-residence certificate.

Panama.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 2% transfer tax; property tax 0.5-1% above exemptions

income_tax.note: territorial: foreign income not taxed.

Costa Rica.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 1.5% transfer + stamps/registry; 0.25% municipal; luxury-home tax

income_tax.note: territorial: foreign income not taxed.

Mexico.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: acquisition tax 2-4%; within 50 km of the coast foreigners buy through a bank trust (fideicomiso)

income_tax.note: worldwide for residents.

home.note: setting up your home (casa habitación) in Mexico makes you resident; with homes in two countries your centre of vital interests decides.

residency.note: no fixed day count; 183 is a rule of thumb.

Uruguay.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 2% transfer tax + fees; contribución inmobiliaria; small wealth tax

income_tax.note: 12% on foreign dividends/interest, but new residents get an 11-year holiday on foreign investment income.

home.note: buy property worth ~US$430k+ and stay 60 days: you can become tax-resident (and use the 11-year holiday).

Philippines.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: documentary stamp + transfer + registration; foreigners cannot own land (condos only)

income_tax.note: resident foreigners are taxed only on Philippine income.

Vietnam.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 0.5% registration fee; foreigners cannot own land, apartments on 50-year terms

income_tax.note: worldwide for residents.

home.note: a registered residence or a rented home on a 183+ day lease makes you resident.

Sri Lanka.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 4% stamp duty; foreigners cannot own land freehold (leases up to 99 yrs)

income_tax.note: worldwide for residents.

Mauritius.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 5% registration duty; foreigners buy through approved schemes (IRS/PDS/smart city)

income_tax.note: 0-20% bands + 15% 'fair share' surcharge on very high incomes; foreign income taxed only if brought in.

residency.note: 183 days in a year OR 270 over 3 years: coming every year, 90+ days/yr makes you resident.

Bahamas.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 10% VAT/stamp on transfers (often split); real-property tax up to 1%

income_tax.note: no personal income tax.

Norway.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 2.5% document duty; municipal property tax; wealth tax ~1%

income_tax.note: dividends ~37.8%; wealth tax ~1% on net assets.

residency.note: 183 days in 12 months OR 270 in 36: coming every year, 90+ days/yr makes you resident.

Sweden.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 1.5% stamp duty; property fee capped (~SEK 9,500/yr)

income_tax.note: 30% on capital income; expert relief for some workers.

home.note: keeping an 'essential connection' (e.g. a home) to Sweden can keep you resident.

Ireland.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: stamp duty 1% up to €1M, 2% above; Local Property Tax

income_tax.note: 40% + USC + PRSI. Non-domiciled residents pay nothing on foreign income kept abroad (remittance basis).

residency.note: 183 days in a year OR 280 over 2 years: coming every year, 140+ days/yr makes you resident.

Slovenia.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 2% transfer tax

income_tax.note: 25% on capital income.

home.note: habitual residence / centre of interests in Slovenia makes you resident.

Bulgaria.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: transfer tax 0.1-3% + notary; non-EU buyers cannot own land directly

income_tax.note: 10% flat; dividends 5%.

Albania.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: low transfer costs; agricultural land restricted for foreigners

income_tax.note: rough: 23% top; capital income ~15%.

home.note: a permanent home in Albania can make you resident.

Morocco.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 4% registration + 1.5% land registry + notary

income_tax.note: worldwide; foreign pensions brought in get a large allowance.

home.note: your 'foyer' in Morocco makes you resident.

Colombia.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: registration + notary ~3%; predial 0.5-1.2%

income_tax.note: worldwide for residents; wealth tax on big fortunes.

Dominican Republic.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 3% transfer tax; IPI 1% above an exemption

income_tax.note: foreign investment income only taxed from your 3rd year of residence.

Germany.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: land transfer tax 3.5-6.5% + notary ~2%; Grundsteuer

income_tax.note: 45% + solidarity surcharge; 25% + soli on capital income.

home.note: any home you keep and use (owned or rented) makes you resident even for short stays; a tax treaty may still assign you to your home country.

Andorra.price_basis: no land listings in the app yet

tax.note: 4% transfer tax; foreign buyers need an investment authorisation

income_tax.note: 10% maximum; 'passive residence' needs 90 days/yr and investment.

residency.note: 183 days; passive residence needs 90 days a year.
